title: "Illinois Traffic Fatalities Over Time"
author: "Ben Jepson"
---







Dataset from

https://idot.illinois.gov/content/dam/soi/en/web/idot/documents/transportation-system/resources/safety/crash-reports/annual-fatalities-1920-2021.pdf

Take this pdf, and find population by year, and look at trends, maybe in light of seat belt legislation, speed limits, other? Might be a blog post not full project





```{r}
# use to read in the dataset
library(pdftools)
library(tidyverse)

mypdf <- pdftools::pdf_text("annual-fatalities-1920-2021.pdf")

#split into lines
lines <- strsplit(mypdf[1], "\n")[[1]]

# remove the top title, and info lines at the bottom
lines_clean <- lines[3:which(str_detect(lines, "Source")) - 1]

# split each line apart
tokens <- str_split(lines_clean, "\\s{2,}") # split every 2 spaces seems to be the structure

# turn tokens list into dataframe
flat <- unlist(tokens)

flat <- flat[flat != ""] # remove empty space

# get the year and numbers paired in dataframe
df <- tibble(raw = flat) %>%
  mutate(group = rep(1:(n()/2), each = 2)) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    year = as.integer(first(raw)),
    fatalities = parse_number(last(raw))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(year) %>% 
    drop_na() %>% 
    select(-group)


```
